Refund Policy

Last updated: 7 October 2026

Overview

This policy explains how refunds and cancellations work for services bought from AM. Marketing and creative work is delivered in stages and involves time, expertise and third-party costs, so refunds depend on the type of service and how much work has been done. The specific terms for your project are stated in your proposal; if they differ from this page, the proposal applies.

LEGAL REVIEW REQUIRED: This policy needs the owner's decisions on deposits, notice periods, money-back conditions and dispute handling. It is not a statement of consumer-law rights, which cannot be limited by contract. A lawyer should review it against Pakistani consumer and contract law.

Advertising spend

Money you pay to advertising platforms such as Google or Meta goes to those platforms. We cannot refund it, and refunds depend on the platform's own policies. Where we place spend on your behalf, the proposal explains how this is handled.

Monthly retainers

Monthly services are billed in advance or as stated in the proposal. You can cancel by giving written notice as described in your proposal. Work completed and fees for the current period are not refundable once the work for that period has started, except where we have failed to deliver agreed work and cannot put that right.

Fixed-scope projects

Projects such as branding or website design are billed in milestones. A deposit, where charged, reserves our time and starts the work. If you cancel, fees for completed milestones and work already carried out are payable. We will refund any amount paid for work we have not started, less costs we have already incurred with third parties.

If we do not deliver

If we fail to deliver work agreed in the proposal, we will first try to correct it within a reasonable time. If we cannot, we will discuss an appropriate remedy with you, which may include a partial or full refund of the fees for the affected work.

What is not refundable

We do not refund fees because a campaign or project did not reach a target that was not guaranteed in writing, because market conditions changed, or because a third-party platform changed its rules or restricted an account for reasons outside our control. Delays caused by late approvals, content or access from your side are also not grounds for refund.

How to request a refund

Email awaiq310@gmail.com with your invoice number and the reason for your request. We will acknowledge it, review the work delivered and reply in writing. Approved refunds are paid by the original payment method or another agreed method within a reasonable time.

NEEDS CONFIGURATION: State the real response and payment times and the payment methods used.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy. The version in force on the date of your proposal applies to that project. Last updated: 7 October 2026.
